info.title: File Conversion
info.description: The file conversion API allows you to convert files from one format to another programmatically as well as submitting files to banking partners directly. This API supports a variety of file types and conversion options to meet your needs.

post.description: Upload a file for conversion or submission to a banking partner.

SourceFileName.description: The name of the source file to be uploaded for conversion

SourceFile.description: The source file content to be uploaded for conversion, base64 encoded

Service.description: Service type: Debit (Collect funds) or Credit (Send funds)

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

FileConversionID.description: The ID of the file conversion job

TransactionCount.description: The number of transactions processed in the file

TotalAmount.description: The total amount processed in the file

Currency.description: The currency of the total amount processed in the file

post.description: Submit an uploaded file for processing and transmission to a banking partner.

FileConversionID.description: The ID of the file conversion job returned from the upload endpoint

FileConversionConfigurationID.description: The ID of the file conversion configuration to use for processing

ValueDate.description: The value date for the transactions (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to current date if not provided

PaymentRail.description: The primary payment rail to use for processing

AlternatePaymentRail.description: An alternate payment rail to use if the primary rail is unavailable

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

TotalTransactions.description: The total number of transactions submitted

TotalFailed.description: The number of transactions that failed to submit

Currency.description: The currency of the total amount

parameters.description: An alternate payment rail used for conversion

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

FileConversionID.description: The ID of the file conversion job

get.description: Get available file conversion configurations and supported payment rails for your account.

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return

parameters.description: Number of records to skip for pagination

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

NumberOfRecords.description: Number of conversion records returned in this response

Conversions.description: Collection of file conversion history records

FileConversionID.description: Unique ID of the file conversion

PaymentRail.description: The payment rail used for this conversion

AlternatePaymentRail.description: The alternate payment rail used for this conversion

TransactionCount.description: Number of transactions in the file

TotalAmount.description: Total amount of all transactions in the file

ErrorMessage.description: Error message if the conversion failed

SubmittedDate.description: Date and time the file was submitted

TotalAmounts.description: Breakdown of total amounts by category

TotalRecords.description: Total number of records matching the filter criteria

get.description: Get preprocessing configurations for the authenticated account.

parameters.name: SourceFormat
parameters.description: Filter configurations by source format (e.g., xml, json)

parameters.name: SourceFile
parameters.description: Source file content to analyze for configuration options, base64 encoded

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

FileConversionPreprocessingID.description: Unique ID of the preprocessing configuration

SourceFormat.description: Source file format (e.g., csv, xml, json)

IsDefault.description: Whether this is the default configuration (1 = yes, 0 = no)

get.description: Get formatted transactions for a specific file conversion. Optionally filter by processor to view transactions in the format they would be sent to that provider.

parameters.name: FileConversionID
parameters.description: The ID of the file conversion job

parameters.name: Processor
parameters.description: Filter transactions formatted for a specific processor

parameters.name: IsFailed
parameters.description: Filter to show only failed transactions

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 50)

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip for pagination (default: 0)

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

FileConversionID.description: The ID of the file conversion job

Transactions.description: Collection of transaction records from the file conversion

AccountNumber.description: Bank account number of the beneficiary
